meta.method: Each hotel's own booking engine (or its brand's official engine) rendered in headless Microsoft Edge (Playwright channel msedge) with a desktop user agent. Prices are copied from the JSON the engine returned to the page or from the page text it rendered; none is computed except where noted (Mirai before-tax = engine price minus engine taxes). No third-party OTA was used.
meta.priceBasis: "before-tax" means the nightly room rate before taxes and fees, as North American and most engines quote it; "tax-inclusive" means the engine only displayed a price with VAT/taxes included (UK and Irish engines, Cloudbeds for Hotel Catedral, The Westbury). taxesAndFees carries what the engine said about the difference.
meta.rateNames: Rate names are the engine's own. Member/loyalty prices are labelled in rateName or notes; qualified rates (AAA, senior, government) are kept and flagged in notes.
meta.confirmed: confirmed:true on every rate: read from the hotel's or brand's own engine during this session at readAt.

freehand-los-angeles: Mews returns only the lowest price per rate group (with the id of the rate giving it), so each room type lists one price per rate group; other rates in a group (e.g. Non Refundable beside Advance Purchase) were not individually priced and are not listed. Dorm-bed categories are priced per bed.
the-dean-dublin: Booked as "The Dean Dublin Centre" (SHR property 18224, 33 Harcourt Street) - the chain now calls Harcourt Street "Dublin Centre" beside a second Dublin hotel, The Dean Dublin Docklands (formerly The Mayson).
